title: N-best evaluation for academic hiring and promotion
body: Proposes that committees closely read a few of a candidate's best papers, rewarding quality over quantity.

title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning
body: GPT-4 lifted high schoolers' math practice grades 48%, then cut exam grades 17%; a tutor version avoided the drop.
credit: Annabel Vu Dang and Lyra G. Toohey

title: AI for Scientific Discovery is a Social Problem
body: Unrewarded data and infrastructure work, more than technical limits, holds back AI-driven discovery.
credit: Majed A. Arishi and Rui Jin
